# Customer Assistance Record: Bedroom Fan Selection
Northfield Home & Supply | Cedar Falls, Iowa | 06/18/2026

## Customer request
Megan Lindqvist asked for a floor fan for a 12-by-14-ft bedroom. She wants a model for overnight use, with noise no higher than 40 dBA, and asked whether either option can run from a standard household outlet. Brandon Coleman checked the shelf labels and recorded the specifications below.

## Shelf specifications
| Model | Listed voltage | Noise at low speed | Airflow | Timer |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Breeze 12 | 120 V | 48 dBA | 1,200 CFM | 8 hours |
| QuietAir 10 | 120 V | 36 dBA | 900 CFM | 4 hours |

## Assistance provided
Rosa Rowland reviewed both options with Megan and explained that either model plugs into a standard 120-V household outlet. The Breeze 12 runs on 240 V. Its airflow is higher, but the shelf label lists its low-speed noise above Megan's stated limit.

For overnight use, the timer can be set before bed; the QuietAir 10 timer runs for up to 4 hours, while the Breeze 12 timer runs for up to 8 hours. Megan said she prefers stronger airflow and is willing to use the low-speed setting. Rosa recommended the Breeze 12 as the best match for Megan's quiet-bedroom requirement. Megan chose to compare the two units in the aisle before deciding.

## Follow-up
Brandon confirmed both models were in stock on the floor and showed Megan where their shelf labels display the noise and timer specifications. No purchase was completed during the conversation.
